payload.text:
Add PDF to document
Add a Customer Relation Management panel for businesses
Add a price monitoring system for businesses/ services and products panel

Add the option where admin (trainers, freelancers, Oga) can register their business and like-wise can also register to use the app/website. Add admin/users can also search for workers for the jobs they are offering within the environment, whether plumbing, carpentry, instructor, front/backend developer, graphics designer, business centers, realtors, properties for sale/ lease.
In the case of a admin(tutor/teacher/trainer/skilled person)he /she can register themselves as trainer with their credentials for prove and also pictures backing their claims on their profile or timeline and ratings. add people come to the platform to choose anyone they want for any specific tasks/ job within their locality/somewhere else.
Add real estate, house/properties can be posted on this platform and interested people can see these properties with their detailed information and can make payment (payments can be done using the app) for most opportunities in it.

**Developing Feature Roadmap**

I'm currently fleshing out the scope for new features on the Nigerian Apprenticeship Platform. Right now, I'm deeply focused on the technical requirements for the "Add PDF to document" functionality. I'm considering database schema modifications and the front-end interface adjustments to enable users to upload and manage PDF documents effectively.


**Expanding Feature Scope**

I've been busy extending the platform's functionality. My focus now is on incorporating an AI-powered PDF parser within the existing tools, like the image OCR. I've also outlined a CRM panel, a price monitoring system, and enhanced user registration and profiles, which allow more advanced business integration.  Finally, I'm considering adding a job/worker search feature and a real estate section within the platform.


**Updating Platform Navigation**

I'm currently updating the platform navigation within `Layout.tsx`. New items include "CRM", "Real Estate", and "Find Artisans" to facilitate searching for workers, expanding beyond the existing job board. I'm carefully considering whether to group "Jobs" and "Find Artisans" for user clarity. Simultaneously, I'm working on the AI tools module, specifically `geminiService.ts` and `App.tsx`. I'm exploring how to modify `analyzeDocument` to handle PDF mime types by leveraging the Gemini API's PDF support. This involves careful API interaction, ensuring seamless integration of AI-powered document analysis within the platform.


**Integrating PDF Handling**

I'm currently focused on the `AIToolsView` component, adding a file input element that specifically accepts PDF files. My goal is to integrate direct PDF handling, treating PDF uploads as document analysis tasks. I've confirmed that Gemini 1.5 supported PDFs, and I'll confirm if 2.5 does too. If needed, I will treat PDFs as document analysis files. I am starting to add components for the CRM Panel and Price Monitoring, but I'm primarily focused on the PDF integration.


**Defining UI Elements**

I'm currently focused on defining the UI elements for the new features. Specifically, I'm working on the `ServiceFinder` and `RealEstateView` components. I'm adding a search bar for skills, a list of profiles with ratings and credentials, and a "Hire" button. For real estate, I'm designing a list of properties with details and a payment integration. I'll need to expand the User type to include business name, skills, rating, and portfolio details, and then add states and routes in the app component. Finally, the AI Tools View is being adapted to take PDF files.


**Clarifying AI Model Capabilities**

I'm now revisiting the AI model selection, focusing on PDF handling with `gemini-2.5-flash`. While `gemini-1.5-flash` definitely handles PDFs, I'm checking if the new model alias, `gemini-2.5-flash`, can accept base64-encoded PDF data. If it struggles directly, I'll simulate PDF parsing or rely on explicit user instructions. I'm building a very basic CRM table view with Name, Contact, Status, and Value columns, and a price monitoring dashboard to display current commodity prices.


**Constructing New Views**

I'm presently building the new `ServiceFinder` and `RealEstateView` components.  These will present user and property cards respectively, each card having key details like rating and payment options. Simultaneously, I'm defining the necessary data types for the CRM, pricing, and new service listings within `types.ts`, and I'm updating `mockData.ts` accordingly. I also have to update the navigation in `Layout.tsx` and extend `App.tsx` with routing and state management. Finally, I'm revisiting the AI Tools View, currently inside of `App.tsx`, and ensuring proper document parsing.


**Defining Additional Features**

I'm currently creating the new `ServiceFinder` and `RealEstateView` components as independent files to reduce the complexity of the main `App.tsx`. In the `App.tsx`, I plan to add the business profile tab in the dashboard or a separate profile view that can receive business data and also incorporate routing and state management for the new views. I'll need to update `types.ts` and `mockData.ts` to accommodate the expanded user information.  Finally, I am making sure the new views integrate into the application as a whole.


**Finalizing Business Tools**

I'm now revising the navigation structure. I've decided to group "CRM" and "Price Monitor" under a new "Business Tools" section in the navigation for better organization. Simultaneously, I'm updating `types.ts` to include the `Property`, `WorkerProfile`, `CRMCustomer`, and `MarketPrice` interfaces, defining the structure for real estate listings, worker profiles, customer data, and price monitoring information within the platform.


**Finalizing Feature Integration**

My latest focus has been on integrating the new components and features seamlessly. I've finished implementing the mock data and defined all necessary data structures. I am currently working on implementing Gemini PDF processing, while also making sure that the new components for business tools, the real estate view, and worker search integrate properly with the existing layout and routing.


**Finalizing PDF Integration**

I'm currently finalizing the integration of the PDF handling functionality within the `AIToolsView`. I'm focusing on ensuring the file input element correctly accepts both image and PDF file types. I'm also addressing the file upload process, preparing the data for the AI model to analyze. My goal is to streamline the document analysis workflow within the platform.


**Refactoring Gemini Functionality**

I'm currently renaming the `analyzeDocument` function to handle generic `base64Data` and `mimeType` in `geminiService.ts`. I'll update all calls to reflect this change. Also, I'm adjusting the image processing function to correctly handle data URLs. I'm focusing on consistency in data handling and ensuring all file types are processed.


**Integrating View Components**

I'm currently integrating the new `ServiceFinder` and `RealEstateView` components. I'm focusing on their layout within the application, ensuring a seamless experience and proper data flow. The components will now feature a search input, filtering by category, and a grid of worker cards for the service finder. The real estate view will present a grid of property cards. I'm also planning to integrate payment functionality into property listings, utilizing `onEnroll` style logic for payment processing.

entries.description: Added interfaces for CRM, Real Estate, Market Prices, and expanded User profile for business/worker details.
Added mock data for CRM customers, market prices, properties, and updated users with skills/business details.
Updated analyzeDocument to handle generic file data and prompts including PDF context.
New component for CRM and Price Monitoring tools.
New component for browsing and paying for properties.
New component for searching artisans and workers.
Added navigation items for new features: Service Finder, Real Estate, and Business Hub.
Integrated new views (Real Estate, Service Finder, Business Hub), added payment handling for properties, and updated AI tools to accept PDF.
